desc: The Paper notes page rated by a tap (a phone's touch screen; TTYD_NOTES_PAGE, TTYD_NOTES_TEST: no relay): the chosen note's score sits between the game's left and right arrows, as the Phrase row's value, and a tap on the right one rates it up (0.5.0 only said 'Right rates this note up' to a tap: a touch screen with no stick couldn't rate). At 4:3, the nearest note's row chosen with the stick, then the tap on its right arrow (x 230, its row's middle y -62 in the menus' units)
